notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Notes - Two New Free Tapes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35234021/e608d5383e3fa5271317885812c2f0c280714a5d.png

Thanks for playing Okay, Panic! In this update, we've introduced 10 new minigames spanning two tapes in a free content update!

This update includes:

 New Tapes

Two new Tapes
We've added in two new tapes - Unicron+ and UNICRUSH which contain a total of 10 new minigames set in a new environment! 

Thanks for checking out the Patch Notes!

If you have any issues with any of the new tapes or minigames, please feel free to leave any feedback below!

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes - Adjustments, Discord and New Tape Preview
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35234021/5c17f12e41d027a17755798ee901b371e73aa30e.png

Thanks for playing Okay, Panic! In this update, we've made some more changes and fixes to various microgames to make the experience a bit better, we talk about setting up a Discord server as well as a preview for the next content update!

As always, if you're experiencing any problems playing the game please leave a comment below so we are aware of it and can get on fixing it! Thanks!

This update includes:

 Microgame adjustments
 Discord
 New Tape Preview


Pacing Changes
Based on feedback, we've made various changes to some microgames to make them a bit simpler and more accessible and hopefully more fun.

 Grab n' Pop now has an invisible barrier around it to prevent balloons from flying off too far. There also also less balloons now in Pane OS
 Simplified the High-Five microgame on Pane OS
 Moved the people closer in the 'Poke' minigame to be closer to the player to make it easier with people with smaller playspaces
 Moved the people around in the Pain OS microgame to be more obvious that they exist. Previously you had to turn around to see them which wasn't very obvious. 


Discord 
We've had some request to set up a Discord server, so we figure, why not? 
Jump in, have a chat, give some feedback, report any bugs and maybe even chuck in some ideas for new microgames you might like to see in the future!

Here's the invite link for those interested: https://discord.gg/7C5AZsz

New Tape Preview 
As a part of the games ongoing development, we want to be releasing new content in the form of new Tapes. The first of these new tapes will be the 'Unicron+' tape which will arrive in August as a free content update. The tape will appear in the game once unlocked, but will not be playable until all the new content for it is ready, so stay tuned for that!

Thanks for checking out the Patch Notes!

If you have any further feedback or are experiencing any bugs or issues, please leave a comment below and we'll get right on it!

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch Notes - Bugs, Pacing and Music!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35234021/b97ee0d39d7ad8b250c391f6f3ef0e1ff20da145.png

Thanks for playing Okay, Panic! We hope you're enjoying the initial release, and we hope you're excited for more content to be dropping soon. In the meantime, please read those these changes we've made. Some small, some a bit bigger! If you're loving the game so far, please feel free to let us know how it is in a comment or a review! :) 

Likewise, if you're experiencing any problems playing the game please leave a comment below so we are aware of it and can get on fixing it! Thanks!

This update includes:

 Bug fixes
 Pacing Changes
 Background music


Bug Fixes
Fixed a few bugs that we've had reported. There are still a couple we're looking into as they seem quite edge-case, but we'll update when we have fixes.
 Fixed an issue where the tapes could disappear inside the VHS player and not be retrieved
 Changed the position of the balloons in balloon related microgames so that the balloons should never bounce away unless you knock them yourself or with another balloon


Pacing Changes
Based on feedback, we've made some changes to the pacing of the game to speed things up and make it a bit more hectic
 Microgames will now move on to the next one once it's been won rather than waiting until the time runs out
 The speed of the games will increase over time as you get further into a Tape


Background Music 
We had a lot of feedback around background music, or lack there of, so we've added some in!
 Added music to the main menu. Don't like it? Chuck the Boom Box away!
 Added different tracks in for the different Tapes. To align with the pacing updates, as you get further into the set, the speed of the music also increases


Thanks for checking out the Patch Notes!

If you have any further feedback or are experiencing any bugs or issues, please leave a comment below and we'll get right on it!
